{{Quote|Best prices this side of the galaxy. You check!|Chivz boasts about his prices|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Chivz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who worked as a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] components [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] he ran a stall within the Republic controlled [[Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport]]. Chivz had no hair, [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and green skin. While at his stall he wore white and grey [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and made use of a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chivz first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' which was released in [[2011]] by [[BioWare]]. In the game he serves as a Republic starship upgrades vendor on Corellia. His location was also marked on a map in the accompanying [[Prima Games]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide|strategy guide]].
